name: use-optimistic-action
title: useOptimisticAction
description: Apply a reversible action at once, offer Undo in a toast, and commit only when the Undo window closes; a failed commit reverts and offers Retry.

meta.whenToUse: Reversible actions that should feel instant — archive, delete to trash, move, mark done — with an Undo toast.
meta.whenNotToUse: Irreversible or slow-to-confirm actions (ask first with AlertDialog), or edits that save in place (EditableCell has its own optimistic layer).
